meta.title: The Sports Morning Notice
meta.textType: functional: an event notice with pictures

paragraphs: On Monday, Coach Matt and Teacher Nick pin a notice on the school gate. It says "FAMILY SPORTS MORNING" and "Saturday, nine a.m." The notice has a picture next to each event. There is a race, a volleyball match, and a music warm-up. The music is pop music and rock music. Each family is going to be in a team. Each team gets a flag in a different color. Everyone wears a sports uniform.

The notice also says who is going to help. Tom and Ben are going to hold the finish line for the racing. Lily has a job, too. She is going to give out water. Teacher Nick is going to write the score on a board. "We are going to be busy," says Coach Matt. "Please wear trainers and a hat," he says. "You should bring sunglasses, too." "Please be careful on the field," says Teacher Nick.

A small map shows the way. "Go in through the school gate." "Go straight on to the field." "The tent is on the left." Families can join if they want. There is a break at half past ten. The break is a quarter of an hour long. Lily says, "It is such a good idea!"

The notice looks like a timetable, with times and places. The morning ends at twelve o'clock with lunch. The families usually eat their lunch in the tent. At midday, the field is hot, so the tent is a good place. There is cold water on a table next to it. Tom asks, "Who is going to bring the water?" "I am," says Lily. The last line of the notice asks, "Will you come?"
text.summary: Coach Matt and Teacher Nick pin a notice about a family sports morning on the school gate. The notice has events, helpers, a map, and times.
